programme.title: Destruction Decoded S1 - "Man Made Disasters"
programme.desc: Explore with us how a manmade disaster could be as much destructive as some natural disaster.

programme.title: Massive Moves S1 - "Hawaii House Chop"
programme.desc: A team of house truckers in Hawaii move a stunning house to a new plot of land for an entrepreneur in Honolulu.

programme.title: Massive Moves S1 - "Runway Race"
programme.desc: A family in St Cloud, Minnesota call in a team of house movers to move a beautiful two-storey home, destined to be their son’s first home, to rescue it from the wrecking ball.

programme.title: How Things Work S1 - "Paintball Guns, Ice Machines and Pool Tables"
programme.sub-title: Paintball Guns, Ice Machines and Pool Tables
programme.desc: Paintball gun, floor scrubber, ice machine, pool table, shopping trolley, gas boiler... Using ultra realistic CGI animation, we explode everyday objects into their component parts, to reveal their secret workings.

programme.title: The World of Bridges S1 - "China"
programme.desc: We visit China's most famous Wind and Rain Bridge and the Ponte dei Salti in the Verzasca Valley that literally dates back to the Roman era.

programme.title: The World of Bridges S1 - "Wales"
programme.desc: The Millau Viaduct in the south of France is one of the highest bridge structures in the world while the Pontcysyllte Aqueduct, which stands high over the River Dee in northeast Wales, was built in the 19th century.

programme.title: Space Dealers S1 - "Dealers on a Mission"
programme.desc: Larry takes on an impossible mission: he’s been asked to find an item worn in space by Apollo 15 legend Al Worden. Torie searches for Russian space items for a museum in San Francisco and Cole goes on the hunt for an item from Apollo 13.

programme.title: Space Dealers S1 - "Money Trouble"
programme.desc: Larry gets the offer of a lifetime: a Soviet era space suit. Torie pays big for an Apollo 11 artefact but it’s not what it seems. Cole meets Apollo 7 legend Walt Cunningham.

programme.title: Space Dealers S1 - "The Apollo Sale"
programme.desc: Torie’s son Jason joins her on the road. Larry turns ‘gastronaut’ when he comes across some space food; and a collector’s flash sale sees Cole bid for an Apollo 11 item with an incredible story.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1 - "Space Junk Dangers"
programme.desc: A ballistic missile test by India recently shot down one of its own communications satellites. With over 900,000 pieces of debris currently orbiting planet Earth, space trash has become a very real threat to ongoing missions.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S3 - "Getting to Know Rick O'Shea"
programme.desc: In this episode we get know Larry’s friend Rick O’Shea (Ricochet). Terry and Larry test several different films where bullets are manipulated in order to get an amazing result. They test scenes from Skyfall, Suicide Squad, American Ultra, and The Bear.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S3 - "Larry's Shadow"
programme.desc: Larry gets sucked into Terry’s dark and mysterious world because Terry wants to test 2 scenes from the 1994 film with Alec Baldwin, The Shadow. Terry will find out if they can save a man trapped in cement shoes, and then they will do a seemly impossible test.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S3 - "We Hear Ya!"
programme.desc: Larry and Terry test several requests from viewers. They will test a bunch of crazy scenes from Bad Boys 2, Under Siege, A LIcense to Kill, and Bangkok Dangerous.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S3 - "D-Day By Air"
programme.desc: Terry goes back to paratrooper school and will see how difficult it was for soldiers engaging the enemy while parachuting down to safety on D-Day. He will attempt with 3 different weapons to hit several targets while descending from the air.

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S2 - "Anatomy of the House"
programme.desc: From living in caves to grand mansions, shelter has always been high on the list of our priorities. Bur form and function varies wildly throughout civilizations.

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S2 - "Extreme Buildings"
programme.desc: Throughout history, our ancestors have always strived to go higher, bigger, deeper, further - and this is reflected in the buildings and structures around our globe. But what secrets can these ancient structures reveal?

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S2 - "History's Hidden Marvels"
programme.desc: This episode explores some of history's most ingenious, yet lesser-known engineering solutions.

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S2 - "Ancient Waterways"
programme.desc: The ancient ancestors realized that building structures and machines to harness water to provide transport, power, drainage and irrigation was vital to the success of their civilizations.

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S2 - "Building Bridges"
programme.desc: Our ancient ancestors had to come up with ingenious solutions and structures to travel freely - over the hills, valleys and rivers of our world.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered S1 - "Somalia Pirates & Black Hawkdown"
programme.desc: On the 3 October 1993, an elite battle unit of the US army began a fairly straight-forward mission in Somalia’s capital Mogadishu. Within minutes of reaching their destination, the situation descended into chaos and the mission turned into a battle.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered S1 - "Battleground Bosnia"
programme.desc: On the 3 March 1992, Bosnia Herzegovina gained its independence from Yugoslavia. Immediately, the Serb-led military units took over large slabs of land and suppressed the other ethnic groups.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered S1 - "Kashmir Powder Keg"
programme.desc: With Kashmir’s special status removed in early August 2019 and terrorist attacks plaguing the region since earlier in the year, the India/Pakistani border-conflict has escalated once more.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered S1 - "Secret War In Laos"
programme.desc: In efforts to remove the Communists, the US conducted a devastating military operation, making Laos the most bombed country per capita - ever. The Laos Civil War has often been called America’s “secret war.”

programme.title: Engineering the Future S2 - "Electric Vehicles"
programme.desc: This film follows the emerging world of Electric Vehicles, the infrastructure needed for them, and the radical change we must make to the way we think about transport.

programme.title: Engineering the Future S2 - "The Metaverse"
programme.desc: This episode is different, it's about an idea, the Metaverse. The Metaverse is the successor to the internet. It will change the lives of almost every human on the planet.

programme.title: Engineering the Future S2 - "Hyperloop"
programme.desc: Virgin Hyperloop is a train that runs inside a steel tunnel. This revolutionary new vehicle floats along the track using magnetic levitation and glides at airline speeds.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Typhoon Fighter, Combat Medics, USS Dwight D. Eisenhower"
programme.sub-title: Typhoon Fighter, Combat Medics, USS Dwight D. Eisenhower
programme.desc: The Military Tech Show captures the moment when BAE System's radical new pilot helmet, the Striker II, goes operational for the first time in a Typhoon fighter aircraft; how interactive technology is helping train military combat medics.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Spear 3 Missile, Battlefield VR, Spy Drones"
programme.sub-title: Spear 3 Missile, Battlefield VR, Spy Drones
programme.desc: European manufacturer MBDA give a hands-on demonstration of their state-of-the-art missile, the Spear 3. Learn how scientists are using a virtual reality headset to see the battlefield in a revealing new way.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Radar Tech, Imperial War Museum, Land Mine Detection"
programme.sub-title: Radar Tech, Imperial War Museum, Land Mine Detection
programme.desc: We have rare access to the German Aerospace Center outside Munich where scientists are using new forms of radar for surveillance and detecting land mines.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "RAF Station, Typhoon Squadron, The Flight Deck"
programme.sub-title: RAF Station, Typhoon Squadron, The Flight Deck
programme.desc: We're at Royal Air Force station Brize Norton, Oxfordshire, where we've been given an exclusive look at the RAF's ground-breaking, multi-role refuelling and transporter aircraft, the Voyager.

programme.title: War Machines S1 - "Mastering Arms"
programme.desc: A weapon that has built Empires, toppled Kingdoms, and slaughtered millions, the story of the gun and how it has evolved throughout the centuries is long.

programme.title: War Machines S1 - "Advancing Destruction"
programme.desc: This episode tells the story of that journey showcasing both big and the small artillery and the impact they have had on warfare.
